finding.reason: Removing trial_process_identity alone is insufficient. semantic_sha256 and wire_sha256 are deterministic functions of condition-varying semantic bytes and therefore can become lookup selectors for preregistered/fixed variants. MediatedSemanticState.sha256() and its per-state factory digest are likewise condition-varying derived selectors even when canonical_semantic_json is not parsed. A behavior-capable wrapper that receives the rich state object can therefore potentially distinguish treatment through representation metadata rather than semantic interpretation.

repair_constraint: Do not implement the current repair as trial_process_identity deletion only.

The behavior capability boundary should receive only the canonical semantic value needed for semantic interpretation, preferably a primitive immutable canonical JSON string/bytes value rather than the verifier-side rich receipt/state object.

Keep trial/source/executor identities, wire digests, semantic digests, per-instance factory digests and provenance/readback metadata verifier-side unless a field is proven treatment-invariant and behavior cannot use it as a selector.
If a sealed verifier-side object remains necessary, terminate that object at the admission boundary and materialize a separate minimal behavior payload for execution.

Regression must inspect not only dataclass public fields but behavior-accessible methods/properties and condition-varying derived metadata; fail if treatment/position can be recovered without semantically interpreting canonical_semantic_json.
After repair, rerun forged-wire, serialized-wire, trial-position and derived-digest adversaries before freezing an exact subject for VPS topology execution.
duplicate_authority_check: No G11, second mediator authority, runtime dispatch or source mutation was created by this delta. It tightens the already-active G10 in-place repair acceptance boundary.
next_exact_action: Existing G10 owner implements one capability cut: verifier-side rich state/receipts terminate before behavior; behavior receives only minimal canonical semantic payload. Then run adversarial selector regressions and exact repository/deterministic-release gates before any VPS dispatch.
